reviews.title: Looks so clean!
reviews.comment: I bought this for my husband for his birthday because he’s a big LoL player and he absolutely loved it! It’s fast, it connected easily to his PC, giving him faster response times when playing his game. If you are a gamer I highly recommend this mouse no5 just because it’s gamer-friendly for all sorts of games, but it’s also durable and a great piece to add to your game room setup!
reviews.author: jaycee a stinson

reviews.title: I had to buy 2 after trying it out
reviews.comment: I wore out a couple versions of the Razer Deathadder left-handed mouse, since those are not made anymore this Logitech G Pro Wireless Gaming Mouse more than fill those Deathadder shoes. The switchable DPI comes in handy. Once you get your game config sorted out in the Logitech G hub software you can store that config on the mouse itself and uninstall the Logitech software. This is the older mouse version and I liked it so much I had to buy a duplicate backup mouse just in case. FWIW, I don't play LoL, I just like the hardware and the sale price. ;-)
reviews.author: bill704
